Terms of Use

Last updated: 7 November 2026

These terms are an agreement between you and The Stillroom (“we”, “us”) for using thestillroom.site. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy.

Who can join

  • You must be at least 18 years old.
  • Use your real name and keep your account details accurate.
  • One account per person. You’re responsible for activity on your account, so keep your password safe.

Community rules

The Stillroom is meant to be a calm, kind space. You agree not to:

  • Harass, threaten, bully, stalk or intimidate anyone.
  • Post hate speech, or discriminate based on religion, caste, gender, sexuality, race, disability or origin.
  • Post sexual content, or send unwanted romantic or sexual advances. This isn’t a dating app.
  • Spam, sell, recruit, or promote MLM or “business opportunities”.
  • Impersonate others or create fake accounts.
  • Share other people’s personal information without their permission.
  • Post anything illegal, or that infringes someone else’s rights.
  • Scrape the site, attack it, or try to access data that isn’t yours.

Meeting people in person

Events and meetups are organised by members, not by us. We don’t run background checks and can’t guarantee anyone’s identity or behaviour. Please:

  • Meet in public places, especially the first time.
  • Tell a friend where you’re going.
  • Arrange your own travel, and don’t share financial details.
  • Leave if you feel uncomfortable, and report anything worrying to us.

You take part in meetups at your own risk. In an emergency, contact local police (112 in India).

Your content

You own what you post. By posting on The Stillroom, you give us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, display and share it within the service so it works as intended. You’re responsible for what you post and confirm you have the right to share it.

Moderation and reports

You can block anyone from their profile. To report content or a member, email support@thestillroom.site. We may remove content or suspend or delete accounts that break these terms or put others at risk, with or without notice. We act on valid legal requests and court orders.

Ending your account

You can stop using The Stillroom at any time and ask us to delete your account by emailing support@thestillroom.site. We may close accounts that break these terms.

The service

The Stillroom is free and provided “as is”. We’re a small team and the site may change, have bugs, or be unavailable at times. We may add, change or remove features, including adding paid features later — we’ll tell you before anything you use starts costing money.

To the extent the law allows, The Stillroom is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for the actions of members on or off the site, including at meetups. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Indian consumer law.

We may update these terms. We’ll change the date above and, for significant changes, notify members in the app. Continuing to use the site means you accept the updated terms.

Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India.

Contact and grievances

Questions or complaints, including about content on the site: support@thestillroom.site. We aim to acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 days.
